correctness.rationale: On the standard triangle the top-cap vertices give explicit centroids C1(r) for q-cap triangles, and C2(r) for complements of p-triangles. Their induced Green determinants integrate to (p+q log q)/9 and p^2(q+p log p)/(9q^2), respectively; six equal normal sectors and reference area 1/2 imply the claimed normalized area. The junction agrees exactly, the barycentric conic equations follow by substitution, and the complement-first-moment identity proves the reflected large-cap branch. A standalone shoelace/bisection cap integration program independently reconstructed 12 areas and checked 156 conic identities and 99 complementary values; this numerical evidence is not substituted for the proof.
